name: Crispy Pork Schnitzel with Ranch-Dressed Apple & Broccoli Slaw
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Mince chives and place in a medium bowl.
Juice lime into the bowl with the chives.
Add yogurt, mayo, and spices to the bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Quarter and core apples; cut into matchsticks or coarsely grate. Add to the bowl with the dressing, along with the broccoli slaw, and stir to combine. Set aside.
Crack eggs into another medium bowl and beat with a whisk or fork.
Place bread crumbs on a plate.
Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chops in half horizontally to form thin cutlets. Season cutlets with salt and pepper on both sides.
Dip the seasoned cutlets into the beaten egg (letting the excess drip off), then into the bread crumbs, pressing to adhere. Transfer to another plate.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, add the breaded cutlets and cook until golden brown and cooked through, 2-3 minutes per side. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide pork schnitzel and slaw between plates. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
